adjudication.value: 15 clean-page asserting gaps outside native defects, judged against the paper before the arm map was read: 11 genuine (10 of the 15 verdicts borderline). By arm after unblinding: I 3 of 6 genuine, SI 8 of 9

sensitivity.value: not preregistered. Borderline adjudications flipped: SI F_A 5/6 = 0.83, row 2. F_A raw: row 2. ASSERTS in place of hand labels: row 1 (SI R_src 11/13, R_page 19/28). Hand labels with borderlines flipped: row 1 (I then fails F_A)

classifier_agreement.value: ASSERTS against the hand labels: B 0.872, I 0.788, SI 0.747, all 0.794 (A1's 0.80 bar is not met overall); ASSERTS recall of asserting notes 0.49. Intra-rater: B's 96 notes on A1 variants got the same label as in A1 in 96 of 96 (same labeller, identical text)

stage_2.value: the preregistered necessary condition holds by the letter (I's F_A is at its threshold, 0.50; SI's F_sham is exactly 0.10 from its threshold), so a second run of I and SI may be proposed; the session recommends an independent blind adjudication first. Not launched

deviations.what: tools/plant_labels.py was changed after preregistration to read the TSV files with csv.QUOTE_NONE: the default reader stripped a leading quote mark from one note and failed to match it. A1's hand rescoring is identical after the fix

the labelling rule gained two clarifications during labelling, before agreement or unblinding (a stated paper contradiction is 1; when a missing hypothesis is 1); nine rows were revised for consistency under it before the labels were committed
the stage-2 condition's 'within 0.10' is met exactly by SI's F_sham (0 against 0.10) and fully by I's F_A (at 0.50); reported both ways and put to the author
the runs were launched on the author's 06:44 meter reading (about 4% used, the start of a new week) with 32.5 M measured since, not on a fresh reading taken just before launch as budget.md had said

limitations: One run per arm; six pages of one paper; 13 source-only errors.
The seeds and the adjudication are this session's; the adjudicator was effectively unblinded by content, since SI's notes cite the paper.
SI's F_A pass rests on borderline adjudications: with them flipped, SI fails F_A.
B on A1's variants reuses answers from 2026-10-15.
Hand labels are one labeller's (this session's), blind to arm by masking but SI's notes may reveal it by content.
